statement: Every kind of obligation a permit carries is handled before the request proceeds; none is skipped. The pipeline dispatches on the sealed Obligation with an exhaustive when and no else, so a new kind does not compile until it is handled, and a model newer than the pipeline (version skew) fails the request with 500, never a permit.
guards: architecture:ObligationDispatchTest#obligations are dispatched by an exhaustive when without else
architecture:ObligationDispatchTest#no runtime code skips a kind of obligation
